$comment: Source of truth for the Jobs virtual MCP server (Obot vMCP). The skill in jobs/ documents exactly the enabled tools; tests/test_deploy_spec.py fails when the two drift. docs/OPERATIONS.md, 'Jobs vMCP', says how to apply it.
name: Jobs
description: Jobs: the toolset behind the `jobs` (Career Architect) skill, for anything about a job posting, resume, cover letter, application, interview or the person's career records. Tools are prefixed by source. career_architect__* are deterministic checks that score a posting against the person's verified facts and lint and build resumes, letters and the skills index: run them instead of judging by hand. google_docs__* and google_drive__* read and write the person's records, kept as Google Docs in a folder named `Career Architect` in their own Drive (profile, rules, facts, skills index, jobs/<slug>). reactive_resume__* read and write their resumes, saved cover letters and application tracker in Reactive Resume. Every call acts as the signed-in person. Deleting, sharing, bulk edits, imports, locking and Reactive Resume's own AI features are deliberately not exposed. Start with the `jobs` skill; it holds the workflow and rules.

sources.origin: Reactive Resume 5.x MCP endpoint, per-user OAuth

append_to_description.list_resumes: Jobs skill: the person's Master resume is the one whose id is `rr_master` in their `profile` document.
append_to_description.duplicate_resume: Jobs skill: only duplicate the Master for a posting. name is `resume_name` and slug is `resume_slug` from career_architect__resume_patch (name at most 64 characters); tags ["tailored"].
append_to_description.apply_resume_patch: Jobs skill: pass operations exactly as career_architect__resume_patch returned them, and only to the tailored copy just created, never to the Master unless the person asked.
append_to_description.create_cover_letter: Jobs skill: content and recipient come from career_architect__lint_cover (content_html, recipient_html, name); set resumeId and, when a tracker row exists, applicationId.
append_to_description.update_cover_letter: Jobs skill: read_cover_letter first and pass its revision as expectedRevision; never overwrite edits the person made in Reactive Resume.
append_to_description.list_applications: Jobs skill: returns whole records and is very large; filter by tags (the company slug) or status before listing everything.
append_to_description.create_application: Jobs skill: one row per position. Look for an existing row first (list_applications with tags [company slug]); tag new rows with the company slug; status saved.
append_to_description.update_application: Jobs skill: read_application first and send merged lists; one row per position.

descriptions.list_files: Find files and folders in the person's Google Drive. In the Jobs workflow: find the folder named `Career Architect` (mime_type application/vnd.google-apps.folder, file_name_contains "Career Architect") and list its contents with parent_id. mime_type application/vnd.google-apps.document selects Google Docs. Names match as substrings, so "facts" also finds "facts - shared". Returns id, name, mimeType, parents, modifiedTime; up to 50 results by default (raise max_results for large folders).
descriptions.get_file: Get the metadata of one Drive file or folder (name, mimeType, parents, modified time, owner). It does not return content: read a Google Doc with google_docs__get_document.
descriptions.create_folder: Create a folder in the person's Google Drive (the Career Architect workspace, its `jobs` and `_history` folders, one folder per job). Drive allows duplicate names, so list_files first to be sure it does not already exist.
descriptions.update_file: Rename a Drive file or folder and/or move it to another folder (new_parent_id; the file leaves its old folder, `root` means My Drive). Use it to move a newly created Google Doc into the right Career Architect folder and to archive a replaced version into `_history`. It cannot change content.
descriptions.read_file: Read an uploaded file (PDF, Word, text) as markdown, for example an existing resume the person wants imported. Do NOT use it for Google Docs in the Career Architect workspace: it exports them as a PDF and garbles the text. Use google_docs__get_document for those.

descriptions.get_document: Read a Google Doc as markdown. Returns title, markdown_content and revision_id. Use it for every document in the Career Architect workspace (profile, rules, skills, facts - <role id>, jobs/<slug>/...). Pass markdown_content unchanged to the career_architect__ tools; they clean it (Docs adds a leading section-break line).
descriptions.create_document: Create a Google Doc with a title and plain-text initial_content. It is created in the root of My Drive, so immediately move it into the right Career Architect folder with google_drive__update_file (new_parent_id). Write the text exactly as it should be read back; YAML and markdown stay literal.
descriptions.replace_text: Replace every occurrence of find_text in a Google Doc (Google keeps the old version in the doc's version history). Use it for a one-line correction only after the text you just read shows find_text occurs exactly once (include surrounding words) and the person confirmed the change. For anything larger, create a new document instead.
descriptions.append_text: Append text to the end of a Google Doc, for example a new line in a log. It cannot rewrite or remove existing text.
